This is a worker artifact; it is not a gate verdict and cannot set validation_status=passed.

target.drift_rule: FAIL-CLOSED: if the live sha256 of either path differs from expected_sha256 at snapshot time (or at final integrity re-hash), abort the adjudication and report hash drift instead of a verdict; superseded bytes must not be adjudicated.
target.read_only: no canonical or authoring file is edited; the reviewed bytes are copied under artifacts/worker-026/f1_adjudication/snapshot/ only

independence.conflict_note: worker-026 has never authored, edited, or mirrored schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml or any F1/F2 formulation artifact. Its prior work is an L1 citation spot check; it has no stake in the F1 verdict.
independence.disclosure: Interactive reconnaissance preceded this registration: the target finding list below was collected from reviews written 00:19-00:22, and the F1 text was read to pose the probe questions. No status label and no verdict was fixed before this file. The status rubric, the blocking rubric and the verdict rule below are frozen now, before the formal probe run.

target_findings.claim: quantifiers.formal (whole-curve containment 'not exists q with gamma subset J^-(q)') is strictly weaker than / not the exact negation of the class's canonical single-q TAIL visibility predicate (visibility.definition), so the class as formally expanded is not equivalent to the F0 AF-WCC-VAC-GEN conclusion object.
target_findings.probe: extract the exact bytes of quantifiers.formal, quantifiers.domains.D5, quantifiers.negation, visibility.definition, visibility.negation_conclusion, conclusion.statement_formal; decide equivalence of the two containment predicates for future-directed causal geodesics under the declared J^- semantics
target_findings.decision: REPRODUCED iff the two predicates are not equivalent on the pinned text under standard causal-past semantics; REFUTED iff they are provably equivalent for every future-directed causal geodesic admitted by D4

target_findings.claim: conclusion.statement_formal uses the symbols AF_{I+}(M_D) and complete(I+_D), which are not defined at any leaf of the document; the class is declared bound to statement_formal, so equivalence to the F0 text is a reader's reconstruction, not a checkable identity.
target_findings.probe: occurrence census of 'AF_{I+}' and 'complete(' across the pinned snapshot; search for a notation/symbol table; test whether i_plus.definition and i_plus.completeness_definition give an unambiguous referent
target_findings.decision: REPRODUCED iff the symbols have no definitional site and their referent is not uniquely fixed by the document; PARTIAL iff a definitional site exists in prose but no machine-readable symbol binding; REFUTED iff each symbol resolves to a definitional site

cross_schema_check.source: map.gates G-FORM unmet at 00:15:51: 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b, which disables the licensed C0=>C2 transfer'
cross_schema_check.probe: extract data_class.equations, data_class.matter, data_class.regularity_class (default, sobolev_variant s/delta/spaces), genericity.kind from F1/F2a/F2b at their measured hashes and diff the class-relevant tokens
cross_schema_check.decision: REPRODUCED iff a class-relevant token differs (not merely explanatory prose); REFUTED iff the data class is shared field-for-field at the class-relevant depth

status_rubric.REPRODUCED: the pinned bytes exhibit the alleged defect as measured by the probe
status_rubric.REFUTED: the pinned bytes contradict the alleged defect, or the alleged defect rests on a false mathematical step demonstrable from the pinned text
status_rubric.PARTIAL: part of the allegation holds and part does not; the report must name the surviving part
status_rubric.UNDECIDABLE: the probe cannot decide from the pinned bytes alone

blocking_rubric.B: a reproduced defect that changes the class extension, the conclusion type or strength, the quantifier semantics, or prevents extraction of one of the gate-required fields (quantifiers, topology, regularity, genericity, I+, visibility, conclusion_type)
blocking_rubric.N: provenance, binding, timestamp or notation hygiene: does not change the class extension and does not prevent extraction by the ecosystem's canonical readers; recorded as backlog, not as a blocker

verdict_rule.accept: 0 reproduced B findings, at least one target finding adjudicated, and ADJ-1/ADJ-3 decided (not UNDECIDABLE)
verdict_rule.revise: at least one reproduced B finding
verdict_rule.inconclusive: any B-alleged finding (ADJ-1, ADJ-2, ADJ-3, ADJ-4 in that order of weight) is UNDECIDABLE

reporting_rules: every status label carries the exact probe evidence and the snapshot hash it was measured on
the report states that it is advisory worker evidence; only the controller/leads move gates

if the equivalence argument for ADJ-1 is used, it is written as an explicit lemma with its hypotheses (future-directed causal geodesic; J^- past-closed under the transitive causal relation) so it can be checked or falsified line by line
no score is assigned before the probe run; the score is recorded in the review event with its rubric basis
declared_limits: the adjudication is of ALLEGATIONS, not a de novo full review of every field of F1; the full class-binding gate is run as a control and its output recorded
a verdict on F1 at one hash says nothing about F2a/F2b beyond the shared-data-class control ADJ-7
the physics of WCC is not assessed; only the schema's internal contract
the hash may drift between snapshot and final re-hash; any drift voids this adjudication and is reported as such
